Subject: Kickoff: Procurement onboarding & PO requirements — Nimbus Analytics

Hi Ola —

Welcome — excited to get Nimbus started with Redwood. I wanted to kick off procurement onboarding on the vendor side and confirm the PO process so our finance and vendor teams are aligned. High-level asks below; we can cover anything not on this list in a brief call.

1) Required vendor docs: please return your completed vendor onboarding form and W-9 / tax-equivalent docs. I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf as a template.
2) PO requirement: can you confirm whether Nimbus requires an official PO before you will accept invoices, and if so, any mandatory PO fields you require? (PO number format, purchase order reference on invoice, vendor contact on PO, etc.)
3) PO issuance timeline: what lead time do you need from our side once vendor forms are complete? We aim to issue POs within 7–10 business days but want to confirm your expectations.
4) Line-item structure: attached is sample-po-lineitem-template.csv — please confirm preferred granularity (one line per subscription seat / one line per product / separate line per tax/fee). Also let us know any required codes (service codes, deliverable IDs) you need on the invoice to match to a PO.
5) Billing & payment terms: what payment terms does Nimbus expect (NET30, NET45, prepaid)? Please share the AP contact for invoice submission.

Next steps: if you can return the completed checklist + W-9 and answer the PO questions by end of this week, Karthik (cc'd) will prepare the PO and share the anticipated issuance date. If useful, we can schedule a 20-minute alignment call Thurs/Fri.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf, sample-po-lineitem-template.csv

Thanks —

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.example.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Procurement onboarding & PO requirements — Nimbus Analytics

Laura / team —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side:
- We do require a PO number to be issued prior to the first invoice for any new vendor relationship. PO number must be referenced on the invoice (top-right preferred).
- Preferred payment terms: NET30 (can be negotiated for large prepay agreements).
- AP contact for invoices: accounts-payable@nimbus-analytics.com (please route PDF invoices and payment inquiries here).
- Tax docs: attaching our W-9 (Nimbus_W9.pdf). We can also provide VAT/tax-resident docs if needed for non-US entities.

Regarding line items: we prefer one line per billing SKU (monthly subscription or hourly consulting block). Each line should include description, unit quantity, unit price, and start/end date. If there's a separate platform fee or usage surcharge, we'd rather see it as a distinct line item so it maps to our internal GL codes.

A couple of vendor-portal questions: do you require us to register in a vendor portal, or can we simply return documents via email to accounts-payable? Also, do you use an EDI/PO integration or will POs be sent by email?

Happy to hop on a quick call — I have availability Thurs 09/03 10–11am PT.

Best,
Ola
Vendor Operations Lead
Nimbus Analytics
Ola@nimbus-analytics.com

Hi Ola / Laura —

Thanks for the quick response, Ola. A few operational confirmations from finance/procurement side:

1) PO issuance cadence & timeline
- Once we receive the completed vendor_onboarding_checklist + W-9 and confirm insurance (if applicable), Redwood can issue a formal PO within 5–7 business days. For this account we'll target 7 business days to allow for GL mapping and contract linking.
- PO prefix: will use RDW-NIM-XXXXX (internal numbering). Please include that exact string on incoming invoices to ensure automated matching.

2) Line-item guidance (required fields for successful match)
- Description (plain text) — include product/SKU name and brief deliverable note.
- Unit type — examples: "seat/month", "hours", "GB" or "usage-unit".
- Quantity and Unit Price.
- Start/End date or billing period.
- Working code — optional field we can provide for mapping (please leave blank if unknown; we'll add before issuing the PO).

Best practice: one invoice line per SKU/service with taxes and one summarizing invoice total. Avoid embedding multiple non-related charges on a single line. This helps our AP auto-match process.

3) Delivery of PO & EDI
- For Nimbus we will send the PO by email to accounts-payable@nimbus-analytics.com and upload the PO to our vendor folder (link to be shared). We do not require an EDI integration for this engagement.

4) Contract & signature
- We have routed the SOW to DocuSign — link below. Please countersign so we can include the SOW reference on the PO.

DocuSign SOW link: https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123-sow

Attachments: redwood-po-guidance-v2.pdf (detailed internal PO matching guidance)

I'll prepare the PO draft once we have the vendor form and W-9. If you can confirm the AP email is accounts-payable@nimbus-analytics.com and that NET30 is acceptable, we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
